changes.to: Issue #1 (2026-11-24): maker figures from markone.gr/hardware.html — 6 kg payload, 1.5 m/s, 8-10 h per charge (8 h recorded) with dual hot-swap batteries and a docking station for continuous work, LiDAR and proximity sensors in the base, high-resolution RGB and depth cameras in the head, dual 6-axis arms, 5-axis uplifter, five-finger hands with force and tactile sensing. No total DoF, weight or battery capacity is published, so those stay empty. Height is not on the site; the maker's own LinkedIn post (2026-11-16) says it adjusts from 1.7 m to 2.5 m, a range with no single figure, so height_mm stays empty. Price is quote-only. Publicly presented April 2026.
Greek mobile industrial humanoid on an AMR base with a 5-axis uplifter and two 6-axis arms for pick-and-place, machine tending, palletizing and welding.
